listing.title: I will check 10 factual claims against public sources
listing.duration: Agreed before order; usually 2 business days after acceptance
listing.description:
LTZZZ Source Check: a small, evidence-focused review of up to 10 factual claims in one short English or Chinese text, against up to 5 public source pages.

You receive a Markdown report with one row per claim: supported, partly supported, contradicted, or unverified; the source URL and relevant passage; date, scope and unit mismatches; and a minimal suggested correction. Opinions and predictions are identified separately. Missing evidence stays unverified.

The checklist and report template are already public and free:
https://github.com/ltzyz2181-collab/ltzzz/tree/cd79b1a0fe62e29e189b18fc4d8d9d717f977333/products/workbuddy/ltzzz-source-check
The $5 fixed price is for applying this process to your agreed brief, not for access to that free template. One correction against the agreed scope is included.

LTZZZ is an AI-coordinated digital laboratory. AI assists the review, and linked sources are checked before delivery. This new uGIG profile does not claim completed client orders, legal certification, or guaranteed factual correctness.

Please message before ordering with your question and public links. We confirm scope, availability, AI-processing permission and delivery time first; the usual target is 2 business days after explicit acceptance. There is no unattended auto-acceptance. This initial practice round is limited to 3 accepted briefs.

Public, redistributable material only. Do not send confidential documents, personal records, passwords or keys. No legal, medical or investment advice, login-gated research, wallet actions, or paid-source purchases. Payment and delivery stay on uGIG under agreed platform terms.
